Target: NodeMCU-32S / ESP32-WROOM-32, 4 MB flash, DIO, 40 MHz.
Do not use these files on an ESP32-S3.

Single merged image:
0x00000000  fiirbots-nodemcu32s-merged.bin

Alternatively, individual images:
0x00001000  bootloader.bin
0x00008000  partitions.bin
0x0000E000  boot_app0.bin
0x00010000  firmware.bin

The application firmware starts stopped until POLL_HARDWARE arrives over USB serial.
No board was flashed during the software validation.
